records.title: Yoga and Naturopathy Institutes
details: a: Ministry of Ayush has planned to establish a 'Central Research Institute of Yoga and Naturopathy (CRIYN)' consisting of 100 bedded Hospital including treatment block, administration & OPD and residential facilities at an estimated cost of Rs. 93.82 Cr on land measuring Ac. 15.00 cents in Nadimpalem Village, Guntur District, provided by Government of Andhra Pradesh.

records.title: Laying of Foundation stone of Akashvani FM Relay Station in Dahod
details: a to d: The tender process for construction of building, erection of 100 meter steel lattice self-supported tower and procurement of transmitters and allied equipment has also been initiated.
